description: Cline as a VS Code extension, which osquery could not see at all before 5.11.0.
why: This retires a blind spot rather than adding coverage: docs/blind-spots.yaml said VS Code extensions were invisible, which was true at osquery 5.10.0 and false from 5.11.0. Cline and Continue both ship as extensions FIRST, so their primary route was unwatched -- Cline was listed under npm and Continue was not catalogued at all. TWO AGENTS OF THE SAME SHAPE, asserted together on purpose: both are bring-your-own-model extensions that write to your files, so a matcher that found one and not the other would be drawing a distinction nothing in the tree justifies. `cursor` and `windsurf` are forbidden because vscode_edition names them as editions, and an extension found in VS Code must not be read as those products being installed.
known_gaps: min-osquery for this branch is 5.11.0, above the 5.10.0 the rest of the repo declares. On a 5.10.x endpoint the query returns [] and exits 1, which is why it is its own pack entry and its own composed branch.

Neither agent's state directory is exercised. ~/.continue does not exist after `code --install-extension` -- verified on a real install -- because it appears on first activation in the editor, and nothing here opens a GUI session. So this proves the extension route and says nothing about the path routes for either.
vscode_edition is reported but not asserted beyond the forbid: this installs into VS Code only, so the cursor, windsurf, vscodium and trae editions the column can report are unexercised.
